answer: Incident, twenty accounts joined inside one hour answering the same prompt. Root cause, the display name was the only uniqueness check. Fix, draw juries from three subnet buckets and void any verdict where two jurors share an operator. First hash each submission onto the bridge. Then replay every hash against the epoch archive. Then let one upheld challenge revoke the answer and hand the bond to the challenger. Cost per duplicate is a bond plus a lost fee, and a gale of new names buys nothing because duplicates are caught by replay. The operator must then wander to fresh infrastructure.
